patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient has experienced gradual yellow discoloration of the skin and generalized pruritus over the past 2 weeks. He also reports a decreased appetite and a weight loss of 6.3 kg (14 lb). The patient’s stool has been pale, and his urine is very dark. Three years ago, he had an episode of acute upper abdominal pain, which was managed with IV fluids, NSAIDs, and dietary modification. The patient has abstained from alcohol for these three years, after having consumed 1–2 beers daily for 40 years. He has a 50-year history of smoking a pack of cigarettes daily.
patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Episode of acute upper abdominal pain treated three years ago. History of long-term alcohol consumption and smoking.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Stopped alcohol consumption three years ago; 50-year history of smoking a pack of cigarettes daily.

objective_for_doctor: Assess the patient and determine the cause of jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, pale stool, and dark urine.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “I’ve had gradually increasing yellow discoloration of my skin and generalized itching for about two weeks. I also haven’t been eating as much, I’ve lost about 6.3 kg, my stools are pale, and my urine has become very dark.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in one or both of your legs (for example, around the ankles or calves)?
turns.patient_answer: “I haven’t noticed any swelling in my legs or around my ankles or calves.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling full more quickly than usual when you eat—like you can’t finish a normal meal because you feel satisfied early?
turns.patient_answer: “Now that you mention it, yes—I’ve been feeling full sooner than usual and I can’t finish my normal meals.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have **thick, yellow or green mucus (sputum)** when you cough—rather than clear or watery mucus?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t have a cough with any thick yellow or green mucus—my sputum, if any, is not that kind. I’ve mainly noticed the yellow skin, itching, pale stools, dark urine, reduced appetite, and getting full quickly.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you notice that the person is limping or putting less weight on one leg?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’m not limping or putting less weight on one leg—I haven’t noticed any change in how I walk or stand. I feel mostly just the yellowing, itching, pale stools, dark urine, decreased appetite, and getting full quickly.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have chest pain that gets worse when you take a deep breath or cough (pleuritic chest pain)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any chest pain, and I don’t notice any pain that gets worse with deep breaths or coughing.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re feeling unwell. **Are you currently having chest pain** (yes or no)?
Have you noticed that one of your shoulders doesn’t move as freely as the other—like it’s harder to lift your arm, reach overhead, or move it behind your back?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any difference in my shoulders or trouble lifting my arm or moving it behind my back. My main issues have been the yellow skin, generalized itching, pale stools, very dark urine, decreased appetite, and feeling full quickly.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever used intravenous drugs (injected drugs into a vein)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I’ve never used intravenous drugs or injected anything into a vein.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have shoulder pain (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t currently have shoulder pain. My main problems have been the yellow discoloration of my skin, generalized itching, pale stools, very dark urine, decreased appetite, and feeling full quickly.”
